note: Both sets read the same curves and share the same over-extended claim that CT ≈ 0.8 holds from 3 to 10.5 m/s (the thrust coefficient is only ~0.45 at 3 m/s), and both repeat several claims verbatim. Set A additionally captures the explicitly annotated Design Point CT = 0.804 and the Region 3 blade-pitch-to-feather trend (~23° at 25 m/s), which Set B omits entirely; B's only unique additions are CT ≈ 0.2 at 17 m/s and thrust ≈ 1.0 MN at 25 m/s. Set B is less coherent on rotor thrust at 10 m/s, giving three mutually inconsistent values (2.25, 2.8, and a "peak" 3.0 MN that is really the axis maximum at ~10.5 m/s), while Set A's errors are a single misread rotor speed (10 RPM at 10 m/s instead of ~7.5) and a slightly inconsistent duplicate blade-pitch reading (22° vs 23° at 25 m/s).
